rv.q: I'll admit that Waitress is in my top ten shows of all time so I may be biased, but this is a flawless production.
Everything about this Tony-nominated musical brought so much joy and happiness into my life.
Still, the show strikes a chord, in large part thanks to Mueller's sweet and touching performance.

cn.t: Critics praise "Waitress" for its big-hearted charm and Sara Bareilles' music, with Jessie Mueller earning particular acclaim for her endearing, down-to-earth performance as Jenna that perfectly captures the character's everyday warmth.
